chunks.content: ## Dressing Models of Different Body Types in CLO This section explains the process of dressing 3D models with different body types in CLO, focusing on importing clothes files, resizing garments, and positioning them accurately using CLO 2026.0 features like the 3D model one-key equalizer and positioning tools. ### Saving and Importing Clothes Files - Begin by saving the clothes files that do not contain any models. - Open a larger body type model (e.g., a dog model with a bigger body). - Import the saved clothes file by clicking **File > Open** and selecting the clothing file. - When importing, choose the appropriate size increase type and confirm. ### Adjusting Clothes Size with CLO 2026.0 - After importing, clothes may require resizing to fit the new model. - Use the **3D Model One-Key Equalizer** function introduced in CLO 2026.0 for size adjustment. - Open the **Adjustment Panel Tool** and select all clothing panels in the 2D window. - Increase the size proportion of the panels as needed. - The 3D window will show the clothes maintaining their original shape but resized proportionally. ### Positioning Clothes on the Model - Use the **Positioning Tool** to move and align clothes correctly on the 3D model. - The positioning tool allows precise translation of garment parts to fit body limbs, such as placing sleeves on legs. - You can further enlarge or shrink panels by right-clicking on the 2D panel and entering the desired scale proportion. - Maintain the garment’s original structure in the 3D view while resizing or repositioning. ### Fine-Tuning Garment Fit - Select individual garment parts (e.g., sleeves) to adjust their position separately. - Drag the positioning ball to align parts properly on the model’s body. - Organize the shape of the entire outfit using the positioning tool to ensure natural fit and appearance. - Repeat adjustments until the garment fits seamlessly on the new body type. ### Displaying Clothes on Different Body Types - Once the clothing is adjusted and positioned, the outfit can be previewed on models of various body types. - This method allows efficient reuse and resizing of clothing assets across different avatars while preserving garment quality and fit. --- This workflow leverages CLO 2026.0’s advanced resizing and positioning tools to quickly adapt clothing for models of different body sizes, ensuring accurate fit and realistic garment presentation in 3D simulations.
